summary.text: Steve Bergquist is a Democratic member of the Washington House of Representatives for District 11-Position 2, in office since January 14, 2013, and he advanced from the August 4, 2026 primary in his bid for re-election.
A former social studies teacher in Renton, he chairs the Joint Higher Education Committee and is vice chair of the Appropriations Committee, according to Ballotpedia's 2023-2024 listing.

paragraphs.text: Bergquist earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Washington, where he double-majored in political science and history, and a Master of Arts in Teaching in social studies from Western Washington University, according to Wikipedia.
He worked as a teacher in Renton, Washington, and operated a small business before his election.
Bergquist was first elected to the House in 2012, succeeding Bob Hasegawa.
Ballotpedia lists his 2023-2024 committee assignments as Appropriations (vice chair), Education, Rules (vice chair) and Joint Higher Education (chair).
Wikipedia says Bergquist and his wife, Avanti, a physician, have two children.
